name: Vantage Data Centers
monetization: Develops and leases hyperscale datacenter campuses — flagship: the $25B/1.4GW Frontier campus for Oracle/OpenAI's Stargate — funded by sponsor equity and ~$38B of bank project debt.
description_md: Vantage Data Centers is a DigitalBridge- and Silver Lake-backed wholesale datacenter developer operating across five continents. It has become a core physical builder of the Stargate program: the $25B+, 1.4GW 'Frontier' mega-campus in Shackelford County, Texas (10 buildings, 3.7M sq ft, first delivery 2026, completion ~2028) and the ~$15B, 902MW 'Lighthouse' campus in Port Washington, Wisconsin — both Oracle-leased for OpenAI workloads. JPMorgan and MUFG lead a ~$38B loan package (with BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs, SocGen, SMBC, Wells Fargo among underwriters) financing these Oracle-linked builds — among the largest project-finance packages ever assembled. Vantage's announced development pipeline exceeds $64B per census research (order-of-magnitude estimate; see observation caveat).
ai_monetization_md: Long-term wholesale leases (typically 10–20 years) to investment-grade-ish tenants: Vantage builds shells, powers them, and collects contracted rent — here principally from Oracle, which in turn serves OpenAI under Stargate. Development is funded campus-by-campus with construction debt (the JPM/MUFG-led facilities price around SOFR+~250bp, ~4-year terms with extension options) that is repaid or refinanced against the lease once stabilized. Vantage also raised ~$11B across nine months (equity/ABS/loans) to drive ~$30B of development, per trade press. Economics therefore depend on the lease chain holding: Vantage's rent ← Oracle's lease payments ← OpenAI's contract payments.
ai_strategy_md: Scale as the hyperscalers' and Stargate's external developer: concentrate capital on mega-campuses (Frontier is its largest-ever investment), pre-lease before building, and recycle sponsor capital through project debt and asset-level securitizations. The Texas/Wisconsin pair positions Vantage as Oracle's build partner of choice alongside Crusoe (Abilene) and Related (Saline Twp). DigitalBridge sponsorship provides repeat institutional LP capital; the >$64B pipeline extends the same model across North America and EMEA.
risk_notes_md: **Single-tenant chain risk:** the flagship campuses are effectively OpenAI exposure intermediated by Oracle's lease — precisely the chain (OpenAI shortfall → Oracle RPO fails to convert → Oracle lease strain → project-finance banks) that SPEC §10.3(b) treats as the canonical contagion path; the ~$38B package's banks are reportedly hedging via Oracle CDS. **Refinancing risk:** ~4-year construction facilities assume takeout markets stay open at completion (2028+); El Paso's 7.53% print shows datacenter credit repricing. **Private opacity:** Vantage's consolidated leverage and the split between sponsor equity and project debt are not public. **Pipeline figure unverified:** the >$64B pipeline is a census-research estimate, not a company disclosure — Frontier's own PR contains no pipeline total.

observations.notes: Loans for Vantage's Texas (incl. ~$22–23B for Frontier/Shackelford) and Wisconsin campuses where Oracle is tenant; underwriters incl. BNP, GS, SocGen, SMBC, Wells Fargo; ~4-yr facilities pricing ~SOFR+250bp with extension options. Project-level debt, not on Vantage's corporate books alone.
Four buildings, ~$15B investment, part of Oracle/OpenAI's Stargate initiative.

observations.method_md: No company disclosure of a pipeline total exists (the Frontier PR contains none). Estimate assembled from announced projects and trade press: Frontier >$25B + Lighthouse ~$15B + the ~$30B development program funded by ~$11B raised over nine months (Data Center Knowledge, Jan 2026), less overlap between programs; the UNIVERSE.md census (Aug 13, 2026) carries >$64B. Treat as order-of-magnitude, floor-biased.
